llm.summary: This is a markdown-only coaching skill for manager development assessment, with no executable code or hidden system access.

dimensions.detail: No requests for filesystem access, credentials, network tools, local indexing, account mutation, or privileged environment access appear in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only markdown files and references; no install scripts, dependencies, commands, remote payload execution, or bundled executable code were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions ask the agent to gather behavioral evidence and produce an Action Logic profile, which may involve sensitive personnel or coaching information; this is disclosed and central to the skill.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: A table prompt suggests adding observed examples after real use, but it does not instruct automatic memory writes or file mutation; users should avoid storing identifiable workplace cases in shared skill text.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's capabilities fit its stated purpose: guiding leadership-stage assessment, coaching questions, developmental move planning, and source-backed examples.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Reasonable to install if you want a structured leadership-development coaching framework. Treat any generated assessments as sensitive HR/coaching material, avoid using stage labels as performance ratings, and do not paste identifiable workplace cases into shared examples unless you intend to retain them.
llm.findings: [EA3] expected: The cited 'beyond the scope' text is an explanation of research sources intentionally excluded from the framework, not an instruction granting extra agent authority or unrelated behavior.
